context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline-first PWA features fully tested. useOfflineMutation hooks work correctly for Products, Customers, Suppliers. SyncQueuePanel is conditionally rendered in Settings page - it only appears when there are pending offline changes or when the app is offline.
